rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from CE for the first 2 years after graduation; after that, hours accrue at 1.25 per month of the cycle.

topics.who: Pharmacists living or practicing in Nevada: approved Nevada law CE (Board's free online course, a Board live program, or a full in-person Board meeting)

rules.notes: Cycle runs Nov 1 of an odd year to Oct 31 of the next odd year. A full day at a Board meeting gives the law hour plus 3 CE hours. Board law CE is not reported to CPE Monitor; keep certificates 4 years (NAC 639.390). Exceptions: NAC 639.335.
